description: This file is a PHP script for the SuiteCRM administration module, specifically handling the repair and rebuild interface. It includes definitions for module list processing, checkbox options for repair tasks, and utilizes the Smarty templating engine to render the interface.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: A class used for Smarty templating engine integration within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the specified Smarty template to generate the repair and rebuild administration interface.
